insight: Founded by self-driving veterans Oliver Cameron and Jeff Hawke; trained on scenes shot with a custom 360° backpack camera rig.
name: Odyssey
tagline: Real-time world model that generates interactive, explorable AI video.
description: Odyssey is a world-model startup whose AI generates interactive video you can steer in real time — explorable, 3D-like scenes streamed frame by frame without a game engine. Its current model, Odyssey-2, turns a text prompt or image into a multi-minute simulation you navigate as it is generated. It is positioned for film, gaming, and interactive media, and is available as a free research-preview experience.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on Odyssey's own real-time world model (Odyssey-2).

edge: Streams interactive, navigable video in real time from a single prompt or image — no game engine, no pre-built assets — unlike clip-only video generators.
pros: No game engine or assets needed
cons: No commercial terms or pricing yet

references.title: Odyssey's new AI model streams 3D interactive worlds
